text:
An adaptive fighter who chooses a specialization at Floor 2 (Beast/Ironscale/Tempest, via the Spirit Guide). This test NPC grants the Beast (werewolf, Fighter/DPS) specialization directly.

Primary: STR | Secondary: CON

MP mechanic: MP = Chi, builds from hitting mobs and Meditate - never decays.

Shared foundation:
Tiger Strike - fast primary punch
Roundhouse Kick - frontal AoE kick
Valkor's Fervor - damage buff + double Chi generation
Meditate - evolving Chi restore + spell damage buff
Martial Form - evolving transformation into your chosen specialization's form

Beast specialization:
Alpha Strike - evolving multi-target blink combo, ends behind the final target
Howling Sequence - evolving rapid multi-hit claw combo
Perfect Form - evolving Attack Speed buff
Break - target takes increased damage
Predator's Pounce (Wolf Fang) - heavy strike that stuns
Blood Sacrifice (Kelberoth Strike) - sacrifice Health for massive damage
Traverse Punch - dash behind the target and strike

Passives:
Bone Memory - consecutive attacks increase damage
Survival Instinct - taking damage grants temporary damage resistance
Feral Hunger - basic attacks restore Health
